scope: Guard selected Storyboard startup/shot clearing/stop-at, shortfall and completion/activity writes and parented AnalyzeScript failure with trusted root ownership. Preserve original settings history and standalone failure contracts.

beforeAfter.before: The existence read was followed by unconditional shot deletion, processing and stop-at writes.
beforeAfter.after: One guarded D1 batch writes status/error/stop-at and its settings activity, plus conditional shot deletion for fresh runs; a miss exits before poster/child work and releases this payload reservation.

beforeAfter.before: Completion unconditionally wrote completed and an activity, then emitted and attempted ready email even after another owner or failure won.
beforeAfter.after: Conditional completion/activity and a stable receipt share a batch. Matching completed owner/event receipts permit a DB retry without another mutation; an ownership/terminal miss skips emission/email.

beforeAfter.before: Credits shortfall unconditionally marked failed and emitted the top-up event.
beforeAfter.after: The existing failure guard decides that transition and whether the top-up event is attempted; text and WorkflowLoggedError remain.

beforeAfter.before: AnalyzeScript used an unconditional sequence status write before parent failure handling and had no root raw claim.
beforeAfter.after: The parent snapshots its actual ID and trusted claim; child failures use that identity for the existing guard and retain specific credential messages. Legacy direct Storyboard hints use only their actual parent ID; unknown hints have no sequence terminal authority.

preservedContracts: failWorkflowIfCurrent signature, organization/owner predicates and failed/completed protection remain after extraction into the lifecycle module.
Current fresh clears shots, resume keeps shots/poster, and snapshot-derived poster/models/locale/country/plans remain. Production Storyboard dispatch continues through triggerStoryboard.

Changed generationStopAt retains original settings event kind, actor, target, fields/changes, null prior value and shared summary. The existing conditional event builder accepts optional SQL data; all constant-data callers are unchanged.
Completed event ID stays in its existing durable step, event kind/wording/actor/target remain, unit failures suppress email, early stops keep email unused, and engine aborts still propagate.

Credential/reservation failure actions and ordinary-error/engine-abort ordering remain. Truly standalone AnalyzeScript calls retain the existing failure path; parent notify envelopes and descendant direct-parent IDs are unchanged.
originalAssertionTreatment: The original Storyboard failure-test prefix is retained. Unconditional start/completion/short method-spy expectations were migrated to guarded calls, with real DB tests retaining shot deletion, stop-at settings history and completed event wording/target. Original AnalyzeScript auth-suite assertions remain apart from formatting and adding explicit fixture identity/mock capabilities. Existing launcher content/model snapshot tests were not edited.

reviewFindings.issue: The first lifecycle start replacement omitted existing stop-at settings history despite an initial 36-file green run.
reviewFindings.resolution: Added 5 focused history/rollback cases (3 red, 2 green), restored insert-select history in the same guarded transaction, and reused the original stage summary through a small pure helper.

alternativeAssessment: Another outer owner read cannot protect subsequent writes. Reuse scoped DB predicates and existing D1 batches, conditional activity builders and stable event IDs. No generic lifecycle framework, timing threshold, new schema, lease or provider fallback was added.
workflowPayloadChange: Optional domain-specific storyboardOwner plus a type-only declaration of the existing _parent shape on AnalyzeScript input. No generic parent-notify wire change.
remainingActions: Unpublished raw claims can still be taken over while create is in flight. The selected writes are guarded, not a strict startup lease or cancellation protocol; poster/analysis content and descendant notifications remain outside complete protection.

The completion receipt covers re-executing its DB operation, not replay of an already-cached successful workflow step or a takeover after a guard succeeds. External realtime/email delivery is not atomic with state.
Failure/shortfall retry can skip notification after the first terminal write. Ordinary adapter errors may be swallowed; events and history/reducer handling still lack run identity.

The standalone AnalyzeScript CLI has no sequence-slot protocol and retains its existing unguarded failure branch; it also has pre-existing incomplete required payload fields. It was not run or certified.
Continue settings save/refusal rollback, independent Update all preflight and create-success/publication-SQL-failure recovery remain open.

Cloudflare durable replay/restart, Workerd HTTP, multi-instance D1 concurrency, real browser delivery, paid providers and wallet settlement remain unverified. Frozen inventory is not approved; GC-03/P3 are in progress and P4 has not started.
